antigravity.Description: Google DeepMind Antigravity advanced agentic coding assistant and pair programmer CLI.
antigravity.InstallInstructions: Install Google DeepMind Antigravity CLI from official website.

gemini.Description: [Discontinued] Legacy Google Gemini CLI for code understanding. Discontinued by Google in favor of Antigravity.
gemini.InstallInstructions: Gemini CLI is no longer supported by Google for individuals. Please install and migrate to Antigravity CLI.

codex.Description: Orchestrates OpenAI Codex coding agent CLI.
codex.InstallInstructions: Install Codex CLI via official OpenAI distribution.

claude.Description: Anthropic Claude Code CLI assistant for deep repository exploration and refactoring.
claude.InstallInstructions: Install Claude Code CLI from official Anthropic distribution.

opencode.Description: Open-source provider-agnostic coding agent supporting cloud and local models (Ollama, vLLM, DeepSeek, Qwen).
opencode.InstallInstructions: Install OpenCode Terminal via official distribution.

copilot.Description: GitHub Copilot CLI agent for pairing, codebase exploration, and autonomous task execution.
copilot.InstallInstructions: Install GitHub Copilot CLI via official GitHub distribution.
